title: Globex renewal call
text:
[13:58] Rep (Dana): Before we talk numbers, how's the rollout going?
[14:05] Customer (Priya, IT lead): Mostly fine. People like the reports.
[14:20] Customer (Priya): Honestly we gave up on SSO after two days and just kept using passwords. The metadata upload never told us what was wrong.
[14:41] Rep (Dana): I think a lot of customers find SSO confusing, we should probably redo the whole admin area.
[15:02] Customer (Priya): Security is asking about it for the renewal, so it does matter to us.
